headline: Contract renewal for McKinney-Vento school transportation with King Gray Coach Lines, $250,000.00, and Amendment No. 6 to Hampden Country Sheriff's Department agreement, $446,949.85.
summary: The meeting includes two votes to recommend contract actions to the full committee. Discussion items cover First Student Transportation reports, contract changes, and electric bus and EPA grant status.
items: Vote to recommend approval of Notice of Exercise of Renewal Option No. 1 for City Contract No. 20260209, Blanket Agreement to Share Costs of McKinney-Vento School Transportation, using King Gray Coach Lines, $250,000.00
Vote to recommend approval of Amendment No. 6 for City Contract No. 20150011, Inter-Governmental Agency Agreement with Hampden Country Sheriff's Department, $446,949.85
Discuss the specific information the School Committee would like in quarterly reports from First Student Transportation
Discuss amending the First Student contract to allow subcontracting, including requests to reduce insurance requirements
Discuss follow up on the status of electric bus deliveries and infrastructure, the EPA grant, and the MOU partnership
location: Springfield City Hall, 36 Court Street 2 FLR, Room 220, Springfield, MA

Dear Mrs. Oyola-Lopez: 
 
The Springfield School Committee Office has scheduled a subcommittee meeting. Please see the 
details provided below: 
 
Legislative & Contracts Subcommittee Meeting 
Wednesday, October 28, 2026 @ 5:00 PM 
Location: Springfield City Hall 
36 Court Street 2 FLR, Room 220, Springfield, MA 
 
All open session meetings may be viewed live & in real-time at: 
https://www.youtube.com/@schoolcommitteeSPS/streams 
 
ORDER OF BUSINESS 
 
I. CALL TO ORDER – ROLL CALL 
II. VOTING ITEMS: 
A. V ote to recommend to the full committee the approval of the Notice of Exercise of Renewal 
Option No. 1 for City Contract No. 20260209, Blanket Agreement to Share Costs of 
McKinney-V ento School Transportation Between the City of Springfield, MA Acting by and 
through the Springfield Public Schools, and other School Districts, using King Gray Coach 
Lines, in the amount of $250,000.00. 
B. V ote to recommend to the full committee the approval of Amendment No. 6 for City Contract 
No. 20150011, Inter-Governmental Agency Agreement Between the City of Springfield and 
the Hampden Country Sheriff's Department, in the amount of $446,949.85. 
III. INFORMATIONAL/DISCUSSION ITEMS: 
A. Discuss the specific information the School Committee would like in the quarterly reports 
from First Student Transportation. 
B. Discuss amending the First Student contract to allow for subcontracting, including requests to 
reduce insurance requirements. 
C. Discuss follow up on the status of the electric bus deliveries and infrastructure, the EPA grant, 
and the MOU partnership.
